details.description: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent is a beta feature of xAI's Grok 4.20 family in which, per xAI's documentation, 'multiple agents collaborate in parallel to perform deep research tasks.' Unlike the other Grok 4.20 variants, its reasoning-effort setting controls how many agents collaborate on a request rather than how deeply a single model reasons, per xAI's reasoning guide. The '-latest' alias points to xAI's newest multi-agent snapshot (currently grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309), and the model takes text and image input, returns text, and supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs over a 1,000,000-token context window.
advantages: Multiple agents collaborate in parallel to perform deep research tasks, per xAI's own model documentation.
Its reasoning-effort parameter controls how many agents work on a request rather than just reasoning depth, per xAI's reasoning guide, letting users scale collaboration for harder research tasks.
Supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs over a 1,000,000-token context window with text and image input (xAI model documentation).
disadvantages: Still labeled 'Beta' on xAI's own model documentation, so behavior and availability may change.
xAI also exposes a separate 'grok-4.20-multi-agent-beta-latest' alias for the same model, underscoring its beta status.
use_cases: Deep, multi-step research tasks that benefit from several collaborating agents working in parallel
Agentic workflows that need tool use and structured outputs alongside a large context window

notes: Not tracked by Artificial Analysis as of research date (its model page for this id returned 404), so no third-party benchmark could be found or verified; evaluations left empty. Catalog facts (1,000,000-token max input/output, image+text in/out, /v1/responses endpoint) match xAI's own model page. xAI's page gives no release date, knowledge cutoff, or benchmark scores for this model.
